How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders are typically processed and shipped within 1–3 business days (Monday through Friday). Express orders placed before 1:00 PM CST ship the same business day, while express orders placed after 1:00 PM CST or on weekends/holidays ship the next business day.
Once your order ships, you will automatically receive an email with your tracking number. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Delivery times depend on the shipping method and destination chosen at checkout. Standard U.S. orders are shipped via USPS, FedEx, or UPS, and express shipping options are also available. International orders are shipped worldwide via FedEx, UPS, USPS Express, or DHL.
Once your package ships, your tracking number will provide the carrier's estimated delivery date. Is there anything else I can help you with?
